thread:
alex (infra): Heads-up: planning a staggered NIC soft-reboot + GPU cooldown in az24 tonight. Window 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll do cohorts of ~12 nodes, 10m drain, 20m cooldown, then validate.
Maria L: thanks alex. which pools exactly? any priority tenants to exempt? :eyes:
jordan: we should shift spike-sensitive tenant traffic to az25 burst pool during this window. capacity there is ~2.2x spare right now.
alex (infra): target pools: az24-gpu-pool-a / az24-gpu-pool-b / az24-edge-lowlat. Priority tenant list: payments (P1) and analytics (P2). payments gets canary exclusion, analytics will be backfilled from burst.
SRE Bot: Incident bot scheduled notice will post 01:50 UTC to #customer-impact if we toggle customer-facing routes. Confirm before 01:40.
alex (infra): plan: cohort size 12, sequential cohorts with 7m node drain grace + 3m prewarm KV seeding, then trigger soft NIC reboot, wait 20m for thermal cooldown and qlen stabilise.
Maria L: cost flag — moving analytics to burst increases egress and GPU-hour billing; estimate ~1.5k USD for the window if we keep full backfill. we can trim by 40% if we do partial batching.
jordan: agree trim. prefer partial batch + KV cache pre-seed. avoid full live migration unless needed.
alex (infra): command sequence for ops:
```
poolctl cohort start --pool az24-gpu-pool-a --cohort 3 --grace 420
poolctl drain --pool az24-gpu-pool-a --cohort 3 --soft-restart nic
# wait for 20m cooldown and metrics stable
poolctl uncordon --pool az24-gpu-pool-a --cohort 3
```
ops-bot: scheduled runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/runbooks/az24-nic-softreboot (will post checklist at 01:45).
SRE Bot: Prometheus alert rule to watch: gpu_temp_max > 78C OR nic_err_rate > 0.5% during reboot windows. We'll mute non-actionable noise.
Maria L: can we reduce cohort size to 8 for az24-edge-lowlat? that pool is more sensitive.
alex (infra): yes, reduce to 8 for lowlat. extend per-cohort cooldown to 25m for that pool.
jordan: quick capacity check: az25 burst currently has 210 spare vGPUs, mean latency bump if we add analytics is +12ms, acceptable.
alex (infra): I'll open cross-region routing policy for the window: route-override analytics->az25-burst for 02:10-04:50 UTC.
Maria L: please add a short customer comm draft for support: "Planned maintenance in az24 may cause short increases in latency for analytics workloads between 02:10-04:50 UTC. Payments unaffected." I'll refine.
SRE Bot: Reminder: run canary on cohort 1 (2 nodes) at 02:05, verify end-to-end p99 < 180ms before proceeding.
alex (infra): canary will be done and signoff by @jordan. Jordan, please ack when canary green.
jordan: ack, I'll be on the canary at 02:05.
ops-bot: preflight checklist (auto): all nodes healthy, backlog < 1k reqs, KV cache seed jobs queued. Status: CHECKLIST_PENDING.
alex (infra): minor config tweak: lower kube evict threshold to 60s for these cohorts to speed drain. I'll push at 01:58.
Maria L: put cost tag on migrated jobs so we can attribute the extra ~1.5k to tonight's maintenance.
SRE Bot: postmortem template pre-created: link https://pm.internal/maint-postmortems/az24-9135792000. Fill sections: timeline, capacity decisions, cost delta, regression checks.
jordan: if anything spikes, failover plan is to abort and rollback route-override, let nodes come back, and delay remaining cohorts by +1h.
alex (infra): agreed. final go/no-go check at 01:50 UTC in this thread. I'll ping the bot to start the runbook at that time.
Maria L: noted. I'll send the customer comm at 01:55 if go.
SRE Bot: scheduled: runbook start 01:50 UTC, canary 02:05.
alex (infra): thanks all — will update here as we hit milestones.
(01:50) alex (infra): GO - preflight green, starting runbook.
(02:12) jordan: canary green. p99 160ms, no errors, proceeding with cohort 1->2 sequence.
(03:10) alex (infra): midway check: cohorts 1-4 done, telemetry healthy. tilt: small NIC packet drops on 1 node in cohort 3, replaced and re-seeded. no customer impact.
(04:48) alex (infra): final cohort finished. uncordoned pools and resumed normal routing at 04:45 UTC.
(04:55) Maria L: cost tracking: final delta ~1.2k USD, analytics bumped, payments unaffected. added tags.
(05:00) alex (infra): closing thread. postmortem link: https://pm.internal/maint-postmortems/az24-9135792000/summary
(05:02) SRE Bot: auto-post: maintenance complete. :white_check_mark:
